newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks end down on economy, Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks end down on economy, Wall Street.

text.p: Thai stocks ended slightly lower in thin trade on Friday as investors sold blue-chip stocks after the release of disappointing economic figures and an overnight fall on Wall Street, brokers said.

The SET index moved in negative territory all day but recovered some ground late in the afternoon to end 3.27 points down at 1,102.32 on 3.2 billion baht trade. Decliners led gainers 155 to 126 while 131 issues were unchanged.
"The mood was poor due to disappointment over economic data released by the central bank on Thursday," said Thaneit Khantigaroon of Ekachart Finance and Securities.
Monthly economic indicators released on Thursday showed still-slack export growth and a rare balance of payments deficit in July.
"The fall on the Wall Street overnight also worried investors today," Thaneit said.
Thai Farmers Bank topped the active list, declining one baht to 173. Finance One declined two to 106 and TPI Polene slipped 1.50 to 71.50.
